propositions: Rebar's single-scalar REBAR_LLM_MODEL cannot express per-pass model tier selection, causing silent failures when operators choose non-default providers
Model selection logic is inverted from equality tests against framework defaults, preventing per-tier downgrades from applying across verifier and completion paths
Model ladders in workflow YAML use bare model names that resolve to anthropic provider directly, bypassing the intended provider configuration on bedrock runs
Three capability classes (trivial, standard, frontier) must be introduced as reserved values in the existing model-string space with lazy resolution through a single function
Config layering for model classes must use deep merge for tables and wholesale replacement for fallback arrays to allow partial environment overrides without duplication

The class resolution function must be called at three distinct sites (resolve_model, ladder expansion, and verifier paths) rather than a single funnel, with function-level imports to avoid module cycles
